mentions.name: Self-hosted car maintenance app
mentions.description: A simple, locally run car maintenance app for tracking vehicle upkeep. It was built because existing car maintenance apps didn't suit the author, and it runs locally (deployed in a k3s cluster).
mentions.problem: The author disliked all the car maintenance apps they had tried, so they built a simpler own solution.
mentions.audience: The author's own personal use; it works well for their purposes.
mentions.source_excerpt: I didn't like any of the car maintenance apps I've tried, so I'm building my own. simpler, can be run locally (I run it in a k3s cluster).
